question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution: The correct answer is: **unintended** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Unintended **means not intended or done deliberately; happening by accident. (इरादा नहीं या जानबूझकर किया गया; दुर्घटनावश हो रहा है) • **Example**: *The unintended consequence of the new policy was a decrease in employee morale.* • In the given context, "**unintended**" is used to convey that the consequences arising from increased reliance on third-party lending service providers were not planned or desired and have had negative effects, particularly with regard to mis-selling to unsuspecting customers. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Intentional: **Deliberate and done on purpose. (जानबूझकर किया गया) • **Expected: **Anticipated or likely to happen. (घटित होने की आशा या संभावना) • **Planned: **Prearranged or designed with a specific purpose in mind. (किसी विशिष्ट उद्देश्य को ध्यान में रखकर पूर्व-व्यवस्थित या डिज़ाइन किया गया) 3f:Ta21, The correct answer is: **breach**
